about: libvips pdfload references for the page-size tests; see tests/common/libvips_reference.rs
invocation: vipsheader -f width|height|bands '<pdf>[dpi=N]'; committed rasters: vips flatten '<pdf>[dpi=N]' tmp.v --background 255 (only when pdfload gives 4 bands), vips rawsave tmp.v tmp.raw, raw RGB PNG-encoded by the test crate (image crate, Best, Adaptive); on-demand rasters: vips flatten '<pdf>[dpi=N]' 'out.png[strip,compression=3]' --background 255
on_demand_note: entries with raster.on_demand are not committed; the tests generate them with libvips when missing and check raster_sha256 (the hash of the decoded RGB bytes)
